text:
Hey, hey, hey!
Did I tell you interrupt me?!
zh:
喂，喂，喂！
我让你打断我了吗？！

text: Yeah, whatever...
zh: 行吧，随便……

text: Sorry!
zh: 抱歉！

text: Don't 'hey, hey, hey' me.
zh: 别对我“喂、喂、喂”的。

text: What did I interrupt?
zh: 我打断什么了？

text: What do you want?
zh: 你想干什么？

text:
I see.
You're a fool, aren't you?
zh:
明白了。
你是个蠢货，对吧？

text: Don't mess with a mage...
zh: 别招惹法师……

text: I was about to...
zh: 我正要……

text:
Never mind.
You wouldn't understand.
zh:
算了。
你不会懂的。

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: Tell me about your work.
zh: 跟我讲讲你的工作吧。

text: What do you think about this letter?
zh: 你怎么看这封信？

text: Do you know how to open a magically sealed door?
zh: 你知道怎么打开被魔法封印的门吗？

text: Do you know how to open a magically sealed door?
zh: 你知道怎么打开被魔法封印的门吗？

text: I want to buy a scroll to open magically sealed doors.
zh: 我想买一卷能打开魔法封印之门的卷轴。

text: What can you teach me?
zh: 你能教我什么？

text: I'd better go then.
zh: 那我还是走吧。

text:
Mpf..
I am #:Lyrak:#.
zh:
哼……
我是#:莱拉克:#。

text: I am a master of astral energies and enchantments.
zh: 我是星界能量与附魔的大师。

text: And who are you?
zh: 那你又是谁？

text: Well ###player.name###... Why are you still here?.
zh: 好吧，###player.name###……你怎么还在这儿？

text: Unless you are an accepted member of our academy, I won't tell you about my work.
zh: 除非你是我们学院正式接纳的成员，否则我不会跟你谈我的工作。

text: Make sure to don't touch anything.
zh: 千万别碰任何东西。

text: What is that?
zh: 那是什么？

text: Gregor, my disciple, wrote this letter.
zh: 这封信是我的弟子格雷戈写的。

text:
Why do you have the letter?
And where is Gregor?
zh:
这封信怎么会在你手上？
格雷戈人呢？

text: I found the letter near a Stonehenge.
zh: 我在一处巨石阵附近捡到了这封信。

text: I don't know where Gregor is.
zh: 我不知道格雷戈在哪儿。

text:
Hmm...
Let me think.
zh:
唔……
让我想想。

text: Then where did you get this letter?
zh: 那这封信你是从哪儿弄来的？

text: The astral energies could...
zh: 星界能量或许……

text: Could...
zh: 或许……

text:
You there!
You are going to help me find out more about the Stonehenge.
zh:
你！
你要帮我查清那座巨石阵的底细。

text: Sure!
zh: 好啊！

text: Why should I?
zh: 我凭什么？

text: No, I won't!
zh: 不，我不干！

text:
Great!
We will meet at the Stonehenge.
zh:
很好！
我们在巨石阵碰头。

text: Because you found the letter!
zh: 因为信是你捡到的！

text: And because I, a mage of the academy, told you so!
zh: 也因为是我——学院的法师——命令你这么做的！

text: You are disrespecting MY order?!
zh: 你竟敢违抗我的命令？！

text: You are not aware of the trouble you are getting yourself into.
zh: 你根本不知道自己惹上了多大的麻烦。

text: Last chance to change your mind!
zh: 最后一次改主意的机会！

text: Ok, I will help you.
zh: 好吧，我帮你。

text: No. I won't let you talk to me like that.
zh: 不。我不许你这样跟我说话。

text:
Then get out of this place!
Warak will find out about this!
zh:
那就滚出这里！
瓦拉克会知道这件事的！

text: Leave this place, you useless brat!
zh: 滚出这里，你这没用的小崽子！

text:
What a strange question.
Of course, I know how to open these doors.
zh:
真是个怪问题。
我当然知道怎么打开那些门。

text: But tell me why you show interest in them.
zh: 不过说说吧，你为什么对它们感兴趣。

text: I want to access an old temple in the swamp.
zh: 我想进入沼泽里的一座古老神殿。

text: I want to open these strange stone doors.
zh: 我想打开那些奇怪的石门。

text: Well. Are you looking for treasures like all the other fools?
zh: 呵。你也和其他蠢货一样在找宝藏？

text:
A temple in the swamp?
I never knew that there was a temple in that forsaken place.
zh:
沼泽里的神殿？
我从不知道那种荒废之地还有神殿。

text: Anyway, I don't have the time, nor the motivation, to teach you how to cast a spell to break magical seals.
zh: 总之，我既没时间，也没兴致教你施展破除魔法封印的法术。

text: Furthermore, you ain't a member of our academy.
zh: 再说了，你又不是我们学院的成员。

text:
However, I can sell you scrolls containing some astral magic.
With these scrolls, you should be able to break the seals.
zh:
不过，我可以卖给你几卷蕴含星界魔法的卷轴。
有了这些卷轴，你应该就能破除封印了。

text: How do I use the scroll?
zh: 卷轴要怎么用？

text: Alright.
zh: 好的。

text: You know how to read, right?
zh: 你识字，对吧？

text: Just stand in front of a door that is sealed and read the text on the scroll.
zh: 站到被封印的门前，念出卷轴上的文字就行。

text:
The scroll's astral magic will break the seal, and the door shall open.
Be aware that this also breaks the scroll.
zh:
卷轴中的星界魔法会破除封印，门便会打开。
注意，卷轴也会随之损毁。

text:
I figured as much.
Just let me know if you want to buy a scroll.
zh:
我猜也是。
想买卷轴的话就告诉我。

text:
Of course.
Here's one I recently finished.
zh:
当然。
这是我最近刚做好的一卷。

text: You can have the scroll for 300 gold.
zh: 300金币，这卷轴就归你。

text: Here are 300 gold for the scroll.
zh: 这是买卷轴的300金币。

text: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text: Don't waste my precious time!
zh: 别浪费我宝贵的时间！

text:
Thank you! Take this scroll.
Now leave this place if there's nothing else.
zh:
多谢！拿好这卷轴。
没别的事就离开这里吧。

text: I study the astral energies.
zh: 我研究星界能量。

text:
However, you wouldn't understand.
Now fulfill your duty as a member of the Academy.
zh:
不过，你不会懂的。
现在去履行你作为学院成员的职责吧。

text: What do you want, brother?
zh: 你想要什么，师弟？

text:
I can show you how to work with astral energies.
What do you want to know?
zh:
我可以教你如何运用星界能量。
你想知道什么？

text: Dark Mastery (min. 15 INT) [4 AP]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_magic_dark_mastery_20","only_once_on_difficulty": true}
zh: 黑暗精通（需智力15）[4 技能点]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_magic_dark_mastery_20","only_once_on_difficulty": true}

text: Holy Mastery (min. 15 INT) [4 AP]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_magic_holy_mastery_20","only_once_on_difficulty": true}
zh: 神圣精通（需智力15）[4 技能点]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_magic_holy_mastery_20","only_once_on_difficulty": true}

text: Summon Mastery (min 10 MAG) [4 AP]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_magic_summon_mastery_20","only_once_on_difficulty": true}
zh: 召唤精通（需魔力10）[4 技能点]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_magic_summon_mastery_20","only_once_on_difficulty": true}

text: That's all I wanted to know.
zh: 我想知道的就这些。

text: Of course.
zh: 当然。

text:
Well, dark astral energies are very special. Many people think they're evil.
Nonsense!
zh:
嗯，黑暗星界能量非常特殊。许多人以为它们是邪恶的。
一派胡言！

text:
When casting spells, try to separate the dark and holy energies.
Draw your power from the holy energy and pass it directly to the dark one.
zh:
施法时，试着将黑暗与神圣能量分离开来。
从神圣能量中汲取力量，再直接导入黑暗能量之中。

text: The sacred energies are not exclusively there to heal ailments or relieve pain.
zh: 神圣能量并非只能用来治愈疾病、缓解疼痛。

text:
When casting spells, try to separate the dark and holy energies.
Draw your power from the dark energy and pass it directly to the holy one.
zh:
施法时，试着将黑暗与神圣能量分离开来。
从黑暗能量中汲取力量，再直接导入神圣能量之中。

text: Your summoned beings will never reach their full potential if you do not understand the connection with astral energies.
zh: 若你不了解召唤物与星界能量之间的联系，它们就永远无法发挥全部潜力。

text: Too many summons of the same type will drain your power, so their possible summoning time will be greatly reduced.
zh: 召唤过多同类造物会耗竭你的力量，它们能维持的召唤时间也会大幅缩短。

text: Give your summoned creatures not only your energy, but also that of those around you. This increases both the duration and the strength of your creatures.
zh: 不要只把你自己的能量赋予召唤物，也要借用周围之人的能量。这既能延长它们的存在时间，也能增强它们的力量。
